en.html:
Another storeroom.
Compared with the first, it contained more trolleys, desks and other bulky articles.

A good place to hide, perhaps, but hiding was not what I needed just now.
On to the next action.

Through the sternward door, I would return to the first storeroom.
If I did not want that, there was only the door on the left as one faced the bow.

ja.html:
ここも倉庫だ。
　最初の場所と比べると、机や<ruby>台車<rt>カート</rt></ruby>など<ruby>嵩張<rt>かさば</rt></ruby>るものが
多い。

　隠れ場所とするには格好かもしれないが、とりあえ
ず今の俺には無用だ。
　次の行動に移ろう。

　船尾方向の扉をくぐれば、最初の倉庫へ戻ることに
なる。
　それが嫌なら、船首に向かって左側にある扉を通る
しかない。

en.html:
Coming?

—Finished searching, and about to leave the room!

Too late to hide now.
We had to take the initiative, burst into the room and subdue the man.

Give him time to raise a noise and call his comrades, and matters would become troublesome.
One blow had to put him out of action. Only—

ja.html:
来る？

　――捜査を終え、部屋から出ようとしているのか！

　今から隠れても間に合うまい。
　先手を打って部屋に飛び込み、制圧するしかない。

　騒ぐ余裕を与え、仲間を呼び寄せられては面倒な事
になる。
　一撃で無力化しなくてはならないが――

en.html:
Our conversation by glances told me we had all reached the same conclusion.
What remained was to decide who would act. The doorway did not look wide enough for two people to enter together.

Decide, then.
The one going in would be...

Footsteps approached the door from inside—again, there seemed no time to hide.
Which left only subduing the man.

Now then. Who this time?

扉の向こうから、足音がこちらへ近付いてくる――
やはり隠れる暇は無さそうだ。
　とすれば、制圧あるのみだが。

　さて、今度は誰が？
